description: This file defines the EmployeeSkill class, a filter field for reports in the OrangeHRM system. It provides functionality to add filtering conditions based on employee skills, convert skill data to array form, and interact with skill entities via a service.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: A filter field class for handling employee skill filtering in the reporting module.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filtering condition to the query builder based on the selected skill if the operator is EQUAL.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in the query for this filter, specifically 'skill'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves the skill entity by ID and returns its ID and name as an array if found.
